issues.where: the snowflake on the table under the globe
issues.what: the snowflake is gone by the last frames of this sheet, while the globe is still up, stays gone through the landing, then grows back across set-D-01.jpg after the globe is seated
issues.fix: keep the snowflake fixed on the table through the shake, and do not grow it back on as a decal after the landing

issues.where: the globe from the hover through the seat
issues.what: the set down eases onto the table with no impact and no settle; the lift in set-A-02.jpg is a small tip on one rim, and the strokes are a soft rock whose tilt does not lag
issues.fix: lift with effort, shake with unequal strokes, a lagging tilt and sharp reversals, and land so the globe settles

issues.where: the snow inside the glass after the landing
issues.what: the storm is a milky fog that thins in place, not flakes that lagged the glass, slammed, turned as one whirl, and fell onto the cabin and the tree
issues.fix: drive the flakes from the glass motion so they lag, slam, whirl, and then fall at many depths onto what they meet

issues.what: a blown-out white orb grows in the middle of the storm and then collapses, apart from the cabin lights
issues.fix: keep the light as the cabin and the tree seen through the snow, with no separate orb

issues.where: the fine streaks on the upper inside of the glass
issues.what: the last wisps crawl in place instead of drifting to rest
issues.fix: let the last flakes drift and settle, with no texture crawl
